FirecrawlReceiveWebhookConfig.description:
Receive any published Firecrawl webhook event.

Firecrawl webhooks are configured per-job by adding a `webhook` object to a
crawl / batch / extract request or to a monitor definition. Firecrawl also
accepts webhook objects on `/agent` in live API testing, and publishes
agent webhook payloads in its webhook OpenAPI. The trigger therefore accepts
any Firecrawl webhook, but only crawl / batch scrape / agent / monitor have
a published event taxonomy suitable for decomposed trigger variants.

webhook_url.description: Reference this URL in a Crawl / Batch Scrape / Monitor webhook field, or any other Firecrawl webhook-capable operation
webhook_url.title: Webhook URL

signing_secret.description: Optional Firecrawl webhook secret used to verify X-Firecrawl-Signature
signing_secret.title: Webhook Signing Secret

event_type.description: Optional exact Firecrawl event type filter. Leave on 'Any published Firecrawl webhook' to accept every event family.
event_type.title: Event Type
